scripts.build: pnpm prisma:generate && tsc -b packages/contracts packages/domain packages/intelligence apps/api && pnpm --filter @peddie/web build && pnpm --filter @peddie/mobile build
scripts.dev:api: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @peddie/api dev
scripts.dev:all: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm build:shared && pnpm --parallel --filter @peddie/api --filter @peddie/web dev
scripts.format: biome check --vcs-use-ignore-file=true biome.json package.json prisma.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json AGENTS.md README.md PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md .impeccable/design.json apps/api/package.json apps/api/tsconfig.json apps/api/src/*.ts apps/api/src/routes apps/mobile/package.json apps/mobile/app.json apps/mobile/eas.json apps/mobile/tsconfig.json apps/mobile/src apps/mobile/modules/adaptfit-pose/index.ts apps/mobile/modules/adaptfit-pose/package.json apps/web/index.html apps/web/package.json apps/web/tsconfig.json apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/src packages/contracts/package.json packages/contracts/tsconfig.json packages/contracts/src packages/domain/package.json packages/domain/tsconfig.json packages/domain/src packages/intelligence/package.json packages/intelligence/tsconfig.json packages/intelligence/src scripts/*.ts scripts/tsconfig.json docs
scripts.format:write: biome check --vcs-use-ignore-file=true --write biome.json package.json prisma.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json AGENTS.md README.md PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md .impeccable/design.json apps/api/package.json apps/api/tsconfig.json apps/api/src/*.ts apps/api/src/routes apps/mobile/package.json apps/mobile/app.json apps/mobile/eas.json apps/mobile/tsconfig.json apps/mobile/src apps/mobile/modules/adaptfit-pose/index.ts apps/mobile/modules/adaptfit-pose/package.json apps/web/index.html apps/web/package.json apps/web/tsconfig.json apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/src packages/contracts/package.json packages/contracts/tsconfig.json packages/contracts/src packages/domain/package.json packages/domain/tsconfig.json packages/domain/src packages/intelligence/package.json packages/intelligence/tsconfig.json packages/intelligence/src scripts/*.ts scripts/tsconfig.json docs
scripts.openapi:check: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @peddie/contracts build && pnpm --filter @peddie/domain build && pnpm --filter @peddie/api build && tsx scripts/openapi-check.ts
scripts.test: pnpm prisma:generate && tsc -b packages/contracts packages/domain packages/intelligence && pnpm -r test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm prisma:generate && tsc -b packages/contracts packages/domain && pnpm --filter @peddie/api test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm prisma:generate && tsc -b packages/contracts packages/domain packages/intelligence apps/api --pretty false && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --pretty false && pnpm --filter @peddie/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @peddie/mobile typecheck
